summary.en: Remote connection manager with an Arm64 MSI (royaltsinstaller_7.04.51113.0_arm64.msi).
summary.zh-TW: 遠端連線管理工具，提供 Arm64 MSI 安裝檔（royaltsinstaller_7.04.51113.0_arm64.msi）。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Plug-ins and connection types may rely on x64 components; not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 外掛與連線類型可能依賴 x64 元件，未測試。
